name: photo-stack
title: Photo Stack
description: A deck of offset cards. Click, press Enter or Space, or drag the top card to send it to the back and reveal the next.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; content: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Cards in the deck; the first starts on top. label names the card for screen readers.

props.name: onCycle
props.description: Called after the top card goes to the back, with the new id order.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the deck. Give it a size, e.g. h-72 w-56.
